entity.name: Citizen Infrastructure Builders Club
entity.description: The Citizen Infrastructure Builders Club (CIBC) is a collective that builds and stewards free, open-source tools putting communities in control of their own information and decisions - community dashboards, decentralised scheduling, fair-sortition, and deliberation infrastructure. Contributions fund hosting, API costs, and continued development across the ecosystem.

projects.name: My Community
projects.description: An online community dashboard as a browser new-tab page - Bluesky feeds, Telegram/Slack digests, and local participation opportunities in one place, community-curated rather than algorithmic.

channels.description: Recurring or one-off contributions via Open Collective (fiscally hosted by The Social Change Nest). Transparent public ledger; funds go to hosting and development.

plans.name: Backer
plans.description: Funds hosting, API costs, and development of open-source citizen infrastructure.

plans.name: Sponsor
plans.description: Sustains the full Citizen Infra ecosystem - hosting, development, and expansion to new communities. Sponsors are listed on the GitHub org page.
